attempted_runs.note: first run, t_total=12000 — observation window too short to reach eps_M; no physical parameter changed

design bug: each arm drove only e OR M with the other forced to 0, so I_write=FET_e*FET_M was identically 0 by construction; NEAR also read s23_lag instead of s23_ov. 12 sims ran in the main checkout, results discarded as carrying no physical information (plan §25 attempted_run)

allowed_interpretation: The system has, for the first time, a minimal causal memory substrate candidate made of a historical eligibility, an independent later physical modulation and a persistent structural state.

registered_limitations.TIER2_LIMITATION: two factors are generated by physical devices, but final factor composition is not a fully self-consistent series-node analog solution
registered_limitations.TIMING_CONTROL: upstream pulse/support duration differs (NEAR 600 steps vs TC 900 steps). Forced by NF-1 latency drift: a 600-step site23 pulse at late timing produces no occurrence (D2-1 s23_far; Posterior-0 probe1_P600). All other items match, and MFS0 consumes only (t_up, t_rearm) via build_phase_drive, so both drive the M chain with the same 639-step phase ramp.
registered_limitations.BLOCK_LIMITATION: single-synapse readout: severing the w-bearing path removes the entire Q input, so post-block equality is structurally guaranteed and is not independent evidence. Informative part: the w-dependent difference is still present upstream of the cut (upstream_bundle_current_rms_diff) and vanishes downstream of it, i.e. it enters the future only via this path. Causal-carrier claim rests on Step G.
registered_limitations.SELECTIVITY_BY_CONSTRUCTION: NC1/NC2/NC4/NC5 and the TC arm are exact zeros because a sub-threshold factor hard-zeroes I_write (DEG-019). S_sel=6.078e+04 is inflated by the EPSILON_Z denominator floor; the selectivity claim rests on D_sel, not on the ratio (§17).
registered_limitations.I_Z_IS_CONSISTENCY_ONLY: I_z observed equals predicted by construction of the Tier-2 gate (§16); it is not independent evidence.
registered_limitations.W_PERSISTENCE_IDENTITY: marginal continuous persistence / integrator-like, NOT a bistable latch
registered_limitations.MEMRISTOR_UPDATE_MISSING_DT: research-side workaround current=I_write*dt used for all arms; DEG to be registered at round close
